meta.purpose: High-level creative and UI guidelines so AI and developers can replicate the Starlink rental portal look consistently across static HTML, PHP templates, and React.
meta.contentNote: Sample copy, kit names, and pricing shown in this file and in reference components are layout placeholders only. Product scope, rates, and inventory come from docs/BASELINE.md and the rental agreement — not from design.json.

creativeDirection.oneLineBrief: A precision logistics portal disguised as a consumer rental site — calm, monochrome, data-forward.
personality: Operational and trustworthy, not playful or startup-cute
Minimal color — black, white, and gray carry 90% of the UI
Satellite / logistics metaphor: orbital, constellation, telemetry, dispatch
Dense information presented with generous whitespace and clear hierarchy
Feels like mission control or a premium shipping dashboard, not a marketing landing page
creativeDirection.visualMetaphor: Mission-control booking console for satellite hardware — numbered steps, mono labels, live status pulses, receipt-style summaries.
avoid: Bright blue marketing hero gradients (old landing-page style)
Rounded-full pill CTAs as the default primary action (use rounded-xl instead)
Stock photo heroes or illustration-heavy marketing blocks
Generic SaaS purple gradients or glassmorphism overload
Overly casual copy or emoji-heavy UI

designPrinciples.name: Monochrome first
designPrinciples.rule: Black (#000) is the primary brand color. Accent blue (#2563eb) appears sparingly — monthly pricing highlights, links, optional emphasis only. Success uses emerald; warnings use amber; errors use red.

designPrinciples.name: Three-font system
designPrinciples.rule: Space Grotesk for display headlines, Inter for body and UI, JetBrains Mono for labels, IDs, prices, timestamps, and technical metadata.

designPrinciples.name: Cards on a soft canvas
designPrinciples.rule: Page background is off-white (#f9fafb). All content lives in white cards with thin gray borders — never floating elements without a border or subtle shadow.

designPrinciples.name: Uppercase mono labels
designPrinciples.rule: Section prefixes, step numbers, and metadata use 9–10px uppercase JetBrains Mono with wide letter-spacing. This is the signature 'control panel' look.

designPrinciples.name: Progressive disclosure
designPrinciples.rule: Multi-step booking flows, expandable FAQ, collapsible kit specs. Show summary first; details on demand.

designPrinciples.name: State is visible
designPrinciples.rule: Calendar blocked dates, booking status badges, live pulse dots, and disabled submit buttons must communicate system state clearly without tooltips alone.

designPrinciples.name: Mobile-first, desktop-dense
designPrinciples.rule: Single column on mobile; 8/4 or 12-column grids on large screens. Sticky sidebars for booking summaries on lg+.

voiceAndTone.style: Confident operational copy with light satellite/logistics vocabulary
voiceAndTone.headlinePattern: [Product category]. [Three short verbs/phrases separated by periods.]
voiceAndTone.headlineExample: Starlink Hardware Rental. Selected. Scheduled. Shipped.
voiceAndTone.bodyStyle: Short sentences. Practical benefits. Mention rugged cases, prepaid return labels, no activation fees where relevant.
voiceAndTone.labelStyle: Uppercase mono micro-labels above human-readable titles (e.g. '01. ORBITAL HARDWARE & SCHEDULE' above 'Instant Booking Portal')

microcopy.primaryCta: Open Interactive Booking Portal | Reserve Slots | Submit Starlink Request
microcopy.secondaryCta: Active Feed | Go To Booking Form | Check Availability
microcopy.emptyStates: Direct user to the next action with a black button
microcopy.success: Reference a booking ID in mono font inside a gray receipt card

aiReplicationChecklist: Load all three Google Fonts before rendering
Set page background to #f9fafb, not white
Use black rounded-xl buttons — never blue primary CTAs
Add uppercase mono micro-labels above every major section
Wrap content in white rounded-2xl bordered cards
Booking page uses 8/4 column split on large screens with sticky sidebar
Calendar shows red blocked dates, black selected range, emerald live dot
Price quotes use amber panel, not blue or green
Status badges use soft semantic pastels with mono uppercase text
Copy tone: operational/satellite logistics, not casual camping marketing
Reference design/src/ for component behavior and design/src/data/rentalData.ts for content
